answer_1.quote: In this paper, we focus on summarizing online messaging conversations (e.g., forums) for which human-annotated datasets are not publicly available, though our method can be applied to other low-resource domains as well.

answer_2.quote: We find that SPF KD achieves substantial gains of 6.6, 0.9, and 2.5 ROUGE-2 scores on Ubuntu, NYC, and BC3, respectively
